audit.why: Levels 1-5 genuinely belong to Viktor: Siphon Power (Q) is 9/8/7/6/5s with a shield and an empowered auto, Hextech Ray (E) is 12/11/10/9/8s at 525 range, and Kassadin is a melee with no mobility until 6. After 6 the lane tax ends and the matchup flips on Riftwalk.
audit.corrected: Difficulty rating 5.5/10 EVEN is consistent with the 53.39% win rate over 2819 games: hard early, decisive late.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 row said Viktor in the content layer and 'Skill' in the full layer, and both whys described Viktor winning the ultimate spike.
audit.why: Arcane Storm (R) is flagged as a channel and costs 120/100/80s. Null Sphere (Q) explicitly 'interrupts channels' on a 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s cooldown, so Kassadin holding Q for the cast denies a 120s ultimate. Riftwalk (R) at 5s also leaves Gravity Field, whose stun requires dwell time.
audit.corrected: Level 6 moves to Kassadin in both layers, with the why rewritten to state the Null Sphere interrupt.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the two decisive interactions: Null Sphere interrupting Arcane Storm's channel, and Viktor's spell spam charging Force Pulse for free.
audit.why: Riot's text for Null Sphere says it interrupts channels; Viktor's R is flagged channel. Force Pulse charges from spells cast in Kassadin's vicinity, and Viktor casts constantly at a 5s Q cooldown at rank 5, so Kassadin's E (21/20/19/18/17s) is essentially always charged in this lane.
audit.corrected: Both interactions written into mid, spikes[1].text, phases[4].why, whys[4] and dosFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Gravity Field is 17/16/15/14/13s and Arcane Storm is 120/100/80s — both are the punishable windows and both are in the kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer called Viktor's ultimate 'Chaos Storm' in six fields.
audit.why: The kit file (Riot Data Dragon) names the R Arcane Storm. Chaos Storm is the pre-rework name.

edits.before: Riftwalk online — the map shrinks and the lane tax ends. One blink changes every gank, trade, and dive equation.
edits.after: Riftwalk online — and Null Sphere interrupts Arcane Storm mid-channel, so his 120s ult is a window you take, not dodge.

edits.before: The AoE lockdown combo remains a real kill threat at this exact power spike, keeping it in his favor.
edits.after: Riftwalk lands and Null Sphere interrupts his Arcane Storm channel, so the level 6 kill threat flips to you.

edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget R Riftwalk for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — 17s at rank 1, 13s at rank 5, and its stun needs dwell time; leave the ring the instant it drops. - Arcane Storm is 120s at rank 1 — the gap after it is your level 6.

edits.before: Q-shield his key spell, W refund the auto, walk — pre-6 trades are accounting; post-6 add a blink and they're arguments you win.
edits.after: Nether Blade refunds mana on every empowered last-hit, so a farmed lane keeps the bar full for 5s Riftwalk chains at 6.

edits.before: Viktor spends Gravity Field early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: His spam charges Force Pulse — every spell near you stacks it toward a free slow cone.

edits.before: Trading like the late game already arrived — a level 5 Kassadin with ambitions is a gold bounty with a shield.
edits.after: Before Rod of Ages, his 5s Siphon Power shields him through anything you start and empowers the auto back.

edits.before: Viktor wins by landing Gravity Field, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Viktor wins by stunning you inside Gravity Field, dropping Arcane Storm on the dwell, and killing you before Rod of Ages.

edits.before: His Chaos Storm and Gravity Field combo is the scarier burst threat the moment both ultimates unlock, so this spike favors him.
edits.after: Siphon Power drops to a 6s cooldown at rank 4 and shields him through your step-up, so these levels stay comfortably his.

edits.before: His Chaos Storm plus Gravity Field combo is a genuine burst threat right as he hits 6, and although Riftwalk gives you a way to dodge parts of the combo, his AoE lockdown still outweighs your still-thin item lead at this exact power spike.
edits.after: Arcane Storm is a channel and Null Sphere interrupts it, so at 6 you hold Q for his cast instead of spending it on the wave, and its 120s rank-1 cooldown makes that gap your whole window. Gravity Field's stun needs dwell time — Riftwalk out the moment the ring lands.

edits.before: With Riftwalk stacks and full items you can blink around his stationary Gravity Field zoning and punish him before Chaos Storm lines up, since he has no dash or true escape once you close the gap, giving you the late-game scaling edge.
edits.after: With Riftwalk stacks and full items you can blink around his stationary Gravity Field zoning and punish him before Arcane Storm lines up, since he has no dash or true escape once you close the gap, giving you the late-game scaling edge.

edits.before: Chaos Storm's AoE damage and Gravity Field stun combo can delete you if you're caught, and even with fresh Riftwalk you have to dodge, not tank, this all-in.
edits.after: Arcane Storm's AoE and the Gravity Field stun can delete you if you're caught, but Arcane Storm is a channel — Null Sphere interrupts the cast if you hold Q for it.

edits.before: You out-mobility his stationary Chaos Storm ultimate, blinking in and out through Riftwalk chains before he can zone you with Gravity Field, giving you the cleaner burst window.
edits.after: You out-mobility his stationary Arcane Storm ultimate, blinking in and out through Riftwalk chains before he can zone you with Gravity Field, giving you the cleaner burst window.

edits.before: Combo Chaos Storm into Gravity Field for a level 6 burst window
edits.after: Combo Arcane Storm into Gravity Field for a level 6 burst window
